events.title: Luther burns the papal bull against him
events.description: Outside Wittenberg's Elster Gate, Martin Luther burned Leo X's bull threatening him with excommunication, along with books of canon law. Rome excommunicated him the following month.
events.html: Outside Wittenberg's Elster Gate, Martin Luther burned Leo X's bull threatening him with excommunication, along with books of canon law. Rome excommunicated him the following month.

events.title: Mississippi becomes the 20th US state
events.description: Mississippi was admitted to the Union. Its fertile lands became the heart of the cotton economy built on slavery, and later a key battleground of the civil rights movement.
events.html: Mississippi was admitted to the Union. Its fertile lands became the heart of the cotton economy built on slavery, and later a key battleground of the civil rights movement.

events.title: Wyoming Territory gives women the vote
events.description: Governor John Campbell signed a law granting women in Wyoming Territory the right to vote and hold office, the first such law in the United States. Wyoming is still called the 'Equality State'.
events.html: Governor John Campbell signed a law granting women in Wyoming Territory the right to vote and hold office, the first such law in the United States. Wyoming is still called the 'Equality State'.

events.title: Alfred Nobel dies in San Remo
events.description: Alfred Nobel, the Swedish chemist who invented dynamite, died in Italy. His will left most of his fortune to fund prizes, first awarded on the anniversary of his death in 1901.

events.title: The UN adopts the Universal Declaration of Human Rights
events.description: Meeting in Paris, the UN General Assembly adopted the Universal Declaration of Human Rights without a vote against. The drafting committee was chaired by Eleanor Roosevelt.
events.html: Meeting in Paris, the UN General Assembly adopted the Universal Declaration of Human Rights without a vote against. The drafting committee was chaired by Eleanor Roosevelt.

intl.name: Human Rights Day
intl.description: Observed on the anniversary of the UN General Assembly's adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in 1948, Human Rights Day reaffirms the inalienable rights and fundamental freedoms to which every person on Earth is entitled.
